metadata.title: Geometric Hybrid Dynamical Systems: Part I - Modeling and Stability
metadata.abstract: We present a framework for the modeling and analysis of geometric hybrid dynamical systems as hybrid inclusions on $C^1$-manifolds. Using tools from nonsmooth and set-valued analysis on manifolds, we derive coordinate-independent sufficient conditions for the existence of nontrivial solutions to this type of systems. We present geometric notions of uniform stability and attractivity of compact sets, and establish their equivalence to metric-based stability notions when the manifold is endowed with a Riemannian structure. We also introduce nonsmooth Lyapunov functions and a hybrid Lyapunov theorem providing sufficient conditions for uniform global asymptotic stability of compact sets. Finally, by characterizing $\omega$-limit sets of precompact solutions, we derive a hybrid invariance principle for geometric hybrid dynamical systems. The results are demonstrated through several running examples.
metadata.comment: 10 pages, 4 figures. Under review at IEEE Transactions on Automatic Control

analysis.workSummary: 在 C¹ 流形上以混杂微分包含建立几何混杂系统框架，给出解存在、稳定性、非光滑 Lyapunov 定理及不变性原理。
analysis.breakthrough: 将坐标无关建模与带 Riemannian 度量的稳定性概念连接。
analysis.limitations: 解存在与稳定性均有充分条件；摘要没有说明任意系统满足全局稳定。 数学分析仅依据摘要和评论，未审读完整证明。 AI 披露另见独立全文检索及命中核查记录；未见披露不代表未使用 AI。

aiReview.note: 对该版本全部可提取页面做 AI 披露关键词检索，并核对命中段落；这不是对整篇数学证明的审读。唯一命中是参考文献中 Artificial Intelligence and Statistics 会议名称，不是本篇使用 AI 的声明。
